name: @appbana/governance-validator
description: Governance Publication Gate (ADR-017) — Phase 1 subset. Composes 10 independently-versioned GateCheck plugins, runs them against a staged CAM, and produces a canonicalised, content-addressed GateReport. Phase 1 ships two real checks (schema-validation, operation-contract-validation); the other eight return a phase-1 stub verdict. Waivers are forbidden for check.schema-validation and check.runtime-compatibility (enforced at waiver-admission time, not policy).
